_comment: Locale fixture (ar). Same schema as site.json; drives the per-locale build loop (buildLocalized) which emits site/ar/index.html with lang=ar dir=rtl (direction derived from the tag). Exercises the RTL seam end to end. Canonical translated copy lives downstream in the workspace mirror.
